caption: What if you were an octopus for a day? You'd wake up with 8 arms, no bones and a hard, parrot-like beak. With no skeleton, an octopus can squeeze through any gap bigger than its beak. About two-thirds of its neurons sit in its arms, so each arm can work on a task on its own. Its suckers taste what they touch. It can change colour, shape and texture in under a tenth of a second, even though its eyes have only one type of light sensor. It has three hearts: two push blood through the gills, one pumps it round the body. The blood is blue because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron. In danger, it squirts ink that hides it and irritates a predator's eyes and sense of smell. Plot twist: the body heart stops beating while an octopus swims, which is why octopuses prefer to crawl. If YOU had 8 arms, what would each one do? 👇
